set.body:
Current assessment — 2026-10-05

Reviewed against local main 7057a8d5a2d898c1bfb528a28f3f635dda639b8b, origin/main 568ce108 (local main clean, 112 ahead/0 behind at audit; no push).

Where we are: The duplicate Aggregation loop and Cats-only locus dependency were removed by the admitted C8 slice. However locusData, package facade, MapEvidence, Parcellation/Searchlight wrappers and process-global DomainFactory remain in actual main. Closed historical child states are not proof those source removals happened.

Fresh context: Yes: partial migration / current removal gap.

Next action: Credit C8, then reconcile actual source against each historical child before facade/registry/wrapper migration and final deletion. Preserve runtime-owner safety, voxel ordinals and explicit provider admission; keep the broad epic deferred unless activated.

Evidence: current modules/locus-data and build.sbt; docs/verification/locus-aggregation-removal-20261004.md; docs/verification/consolidation-20261005.md.

This is a tracker/source/retained-evidence assessment, not a new experiment or test run. Existing acceptance criteria and owner decisions remain binding; dated source-state statements below are superseded where this assessment explicitly corrects them. Status, priority, assignee, claims and dependency edges are unchanged.

---

Previous scope and history (acceptance retained)

Outcome

Delete the scalafim-locus-data artifact after migrating every consumer to the smallest authoritative locus4s artifact. Remove the broad scalafim.locus facade, duplicate map evidence, Parcellation storage/validation, structural Searchlight storage, duplicate aggregation, and the process-global DomainFactory without silently changing voxel ordinal meaning.

External prerequisite

Complete and admit locus4s epic bd-01KZ6B4SF3BS6YH7SHEERM9V6H, especially proof/adoption gate bd-01KZ6B6WCMA9XQ5WAWGXBW3MZ5. Cross-store readiness is represented by a local admission-gate child.

Architecture

- Internal ScalaFIM code imports locus4s and locus4s.data directly.
- Narrow role aliases may remain only at scientific module boundaries.
- Rich AtlasParcellation or searchlight result records are allowed only when they add metadata, hierarchy, construction policy, or provenance beyond the locus4s value.
- Registry ownership follows dataset, archive, workflow, or application lifetime.
- VolumeDomain ordering and persistent grid identity are a separate child of the existing image-unification epic, not a prerequisite for deleting this algebra facade.
- Image and surface modules retain fMRI mask/radius/support and geodesic construction policy while returning locus4s NeighborhoodSystem values.

Migration slices

1. Admit the exact locus4s provider revision.
2. Replace DomainFactory with explicit scoped DomainRegistry ownership while preserving current voxel semantics.
3. Replace Parcellation with PartialSurjection and move all-fiber consumers to the one-pass relation.
4. Replace structural Searchlight and CenteredSearchlight with NeighborhoodSystem values.
5. Remove facade vocabulary and MapEvidence in favor of direct canonical imports and constructors.
6. Remove duplicate aggregation and unnecessary Cats-only locus dependency.
7. Rewire every module to locus4s-core, locus4s-data, or the appropriate bridge and atomically delete locus-data.
8. Run focused and repository-wide cross-platform migration courts and mark the historical plan superseded.

Acceptance

- No production scalafim.locus facade remains.
- No duplicate generic finite-domain storage, validation algebra, relation conversion, fiber loop, neighborhood structure, or aggregation loop remains.
- No process-global registry singleton remains.
- Parcel support, parcel order, center order, neighborhood membership, and owner/alignment failures retain explicit tested semantics.
- JVM and Scala.js focused tests pass after each slice; final sbt compileAll and testAll pass warning-clean.
- build.sbt, README/module maps, aliases, and documentation contain no scalafim-locus-data artifact.
- Volume ordinals are not reinterpreted as part of this deletion; any later image4s-locus migration crosses an explicit checked layout boundary.

Non-goals

Do not add spatial4s-locus, image storage, grid geometry, label-image discovery, metric/geodesic generation, atlas metadata, or another generic wrapper merely to preserve old names.
